caption:
Italy says it was not told of Ukraine's drone strike on Russian ships in Libya

Italy's foreign minister warned parliament that further military action could jeopardize efforts to reunify Libya. Italy has joined the voices expressing concern about Ukraine's attack on Russian ships in Libyan waters.

Reported by Africanews.
